title: Avoid VECTOR_DISTANCE ObjectName uppercase allocation
description: Replace VECTOR_DISTANCE detection via func.name.to_string().to_uppercase() with direct ObjectNamePart matching.

criteria: HNSW ORDER BY VECTOR_DISTANCE projection regression passes

notes: The HNSW ORDER BY scan optimization now reuses the direct ObjectName helper.
No ObjectName display string or uppercase String is allocated for the VECTOR_DISTANCE guard.
The helper test now covers the ObjectNamePart::Function variant used by sqlparser for dynamic object-name parts.
